feeds.title: Loco Golf Co Blog
feeds.description: Find detailed information about the day-to-day operations of our staff. We provide a report to help you understand the outline of the service through specific interactions between staff and students, lesson play measurement, etc. You can also get a feel for the personality of the staff as they talk about their daily impressions, their commitment to lessons, and their ingenuity. Loco Locker is a golf school with attractive lessons that even beginners can enjoy. We have experienced instructors, so lessons for advanced players to improve golf are also possible.

feeds.title: Hiemon Blog
feeds.description: We want everyone who loves golf, from beginners to professionals, to love golf more. We provide a wide range of items, from golf balls, golf goods, apparel, and tote bags, to items that make your rounds more comfortable, to convenient items that you can use every day alongw oth tips, gear reviews and more!

feeds.title: TrackMan Golf Blog
feeds.description: Trackman official blog by Trackman Japan is a wide-ranging information dissemination base, including the latest information, support information, and explanations of data items. Since 2003, TrackMan has been on the forefront of providing reliable performance data solutions and industry-leading innovation to customers all over the world. Our products are used by professional and amateur athletes in a broad spectrum of sports.

feeds.title: Goltame
feeds.description: This blog is a resource of easy-to-understand explanations on how to start playing golf, golf know-how, and how golf beginners can stably break 100 while improving. The reason I started playing golf was that an acquaintance, who was overwhelmed with work, taught me how to play golf. I cut half 50 in half a year and cut 100 in 9 months.

feeds.title: Nara Yagyu Country Club News
feeds.description: Check out seasonal topics, club events, course renovation, renewal work, essays about golf, emotions, etc. Nara Yagyu Country Club is a clubhouse with a tiled roof in Yagyu-no-Sato, the ancient capital of Nara, which has a calm atmosphere - winner of the Nara City Architectural Culture Award and Landscape Award.

feeds.title: Sanko Golf Club Japan Course Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with all the news from club in the blog. Sanko Golf Club Japan Course opened in 1990 with the aim of becoming a legendary golf club that can withstand the evaluation of future generations. Since its opening, the club has made every effort to create a famous course that will contribute to the Japanese golf world in the future.

feeds.title: Anew Golf Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog for the latest products, reviews, and more! Anew Golf is a high-quality and fashionable golf brand that takes inspiration from street and Extreme Sport, breaking away from old designs and proposing strong and impactful styles.

feeds.title: Epon Golf Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog to know more about golf, news from us, tips and more! Epon Golf continues to build golf clubs that give you the distance you've been waiting for, the trajectory you've dreamed of, and the excitement on the green.

feeds.title: Bally Bunion Golf Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest updates on our new equipment, user reviews, expert comments and more! BBGOLF aims to create the most reliable clubs for each golfer based on the concept of 'encountering the best clubs'. We have assembled more than 1200 sets of irons for Miura Giken, EPON, and RODDIO, and we deliver high-precision clubs to our customers by assembling more than 2,000 drivers and other clubs annually.

feeds.title: Shiseikan Golf Club Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest updates and news from the golf club, teams, tournaments and more! Shiseikan University is a place where we learn together with our peers and continue to make efforts to achieve this goal. Students of Shiseikan University can become nursery teachers and kindergarten teachers who stand by and watch over children.

feeds.title: Eastwood Country Club Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest news on our events, and tournaments, find tips for playing golf, and more! At Eastwood Country Club, we strive to provide a golf experience that is as much an escape for the mind as it is a challenge for golfers of all levels. In a setting reminiscent of a tranquil garden, our course features 18 impeccably manicured holes of golf to test your skills and help you take your game to the next level.

feeds.title: Mie Golf Tourism Blog
feeds.description: Mie Golf Tourism Organization (MGTO), formed in July 2015, is a non-profit organization representing the golf tourism cluster in Mie. MGTO's members are inbound tour operators (DMC) and suppliers (golf courses, accommodation, transportation, destinations, attractions, restaurants, etc.) from across the prefecture. MGTO's primary objective is to promote Mie as a unique 'Golf Plus Destination' for international golf travelers. Get the latest news and updates on golf tourism in Japan in this blog.

feeds.title: Disc Golf Navi Blog
feeds.description: This site is a comprehensive site that is useful for disc golf beginners and those who are currently practicing, such as how to play disc golf, rules, courses nationwide, tournament information, disc manufacturers, products and stores, and information about players.

feeds.title: G-Golf Blog
feeds.description: Our blog features more information on golf, history, tournament news, scores, tips, and more! We provide a full-fledged round experience anytime easily and comfortably on the simulation golf course with completely private rooms.

feeds.title: The Golf Japan
feeds.description: Explore more on Japan, golf culture in Japan, travel diaries and more! The Golf Japan Inc. is a DMC (Destination Management Company) specializing in International Golf Tourism to Japan.

feeds.title: Tourspecgolf Blog
feeds.description: We are a source for golf enthusiasts to share information, friendships, experiences, and our common love for golf and equipment, and share more about Golf Clubs, reviews, the domestic market, and more. Our goal is to teach the general golfing public about the new world of Japanese Golf Clubs making more and more products available to golfers.

feeds.title: Everyday Golf
feeds.description: Everyday Golf provides you with a good sweat, good friends, and a good time! Aiming to be a doctor for golfers who are closely related to the community! We aim to be someone who understands your golf better than you! Get the latest news from us, events, tournaments, tips for beginners and more!
